direct_operational.description: Predeclared aggregate full-bandit return with the direct configured confidence scale.

support_fixed_trace.description: Support-derived scale replayed on the recorded target trace; it is not a counterfactual policy execution.

prior_fixed_trace.description: Enlarged-prior scale replayed on the recorded target trace; it is not a counterfactual policy execution.

trajectory_interface_only.description: Shared-reset trajectory-deviation calibration is mathematically available but is not instantiated by the present campaign.
